Return the original label Entailment (supported), Contradiction (opposed), or NotMentioned (not settled by the document); do not substitute external law for contractual text. Decide the relation relative to the exact original hypothesis, including its negation, not whether the contract contains a prohibition. The same 17 hypotheses are checked on every document. All original text is present, with zero-based original span markers <SPAN i>...</SPAN i>. For supported/opposed hypotheses cite all original evidence span indices for that decision, including independently operative redundant support and necessary governing language. For NotMentioned return an empty evidence list. Treat conditions and exceptions within scope, and distinguish limited permission from universal permission. Give a short public reason (at most 15 words per hypothesis), then report supplied skill IDs actually used. Skills are fallible reusable inspection procedures, not facts about this NDA or automatic verdicts. All skills are visible together; public hypothesis IDs describe applicability, not hidden context isolation. Do not execute further tools, invent citations or rewrite span indices. Return exactly the supplied JSON schema with all 17 original hypothesis keys. For each emit choice, spans, reason, used_skill_ids in that order. The common schema describes permitted values, not answers about this contract. Evidence candidates are fallible, not mandatory citations; make every final label and evidence decision yourself from the complete original contract. External skills here are executable SOURCE ACCESS ONLY, not legal advice. The complete original NDA remains present. SOURCE_LEADS immediately before an original SPAN records factual skill/query locations: match means a literal token-phrase hit, neighbour an explicitly requested window, preamble a possible list introduction. None proves relevance, support, opposition or evidence membership. Skill code/teacher advice is not supplied to you. All skill identities and public scopes are visible together. Missing IDs, empty queries/hits and missing ordinary candidates never mean NotMentioned. Read the full source, reject noisy leads and cite ANY original indices as needed, including outside every retrieval. Make every legal decision yourself. Ordinary candidate indices resolve to their exact original text in the one-copy catalogue; their membership scores are fallible, not legal confidence. Report only supplied matching skill IDs you actually used; [] is always legal.

<SPAN 1>TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT</SPAN 1>
<SPAN 2>These Terms and Conditions (“Terms and Conditions”) are attached to and incorporated into a Non-Disclosure Agreement (“NDA”). </SPAN 2><SPAN 3>All Section number references in these Terms and Conditions shall be references to provisions in these Terms and Conditions unless explicitly stated otherwise.</SPAN 3>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[2,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 4>Background</SPAN 4>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[2,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 5>Disclosing Party or Disclosing Parties identified in the NDA own rights in such Party’s Confidential Information. </SPAN 5><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[2,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 6>Each Disclosing </SPAN 6><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[2,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 7>Party considers it desirable to make Party’s Confidential Information available to Receiving Party or Parties for pursuing the Purpose identified in the NDA, subject to the terms and conditions hereof.</SPAN 7>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[2,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 8>1. Definitions.</SPAN 8>
<SPAN 9>“Agreement” means collectively </SPAN 9><SPAN 10>(i) these Terms and Conditions, and </SPAN 10><SPAN 11>(ii) the NDA.</SPAN 11>
<SPAN 12>“Agreement Term” means the period identified as such in Section 3 of the NDA.</SPAN 12>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 13> </SPAN 13><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[0,"matched"]],"source-acquisition-independent-source-v1":[[0,"preamble"],[1,"preamble"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 14>“Confidential Information” means any non-public information of a Disclosing Party described in Section 4 of the NDA which is maintained as confidential, including as examples, biological materials, computer source codes, diagrams, electronic files, invention disclosures, patent applications, technical and scientific information, research data, draft publications, technical reports, research plans, business plans, financial reports, projections, and so forth, but excluding however any information which Receiving Party can establish by competent written proof </SPAN 14><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-independent-source-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 15>(a) was in the public domain as of the Effective Date or comes into the public domain during the term of the Agreement through no fault of Receiving Party; </SPAN 15><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-independent-source-v1":[[0,"neighbour"],[1,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 16>(b) was known to Receiving Party prior to the Effective Date and was not acquired, directly or indirectly, from a Disclosing Party or from a third party under a continuing obligation of confidentiality or limited use; </SPAN 16><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-independent-source-v1":[[0,"matched"],[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 17>(c) was independently developed by Receiving Party without substantive knowledge of or assistance from the Confidential Information; or </SPAN 17><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-independent-source-v1":[[0,"neighbour"],[1,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 18>(d) was lawfully disclosed to Receiving Party from a third party who did not require Receiving Party to hold it in confidence or limit its use and who did not acquire it, directly or indirectly, from Disclosing Party under a continuing obligation of confidentiality.</SPAN 18>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[2,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-independent-source-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 19>“Confidentiality Term” means the period identified as such in Section 3 of the NDA.</SPAN 19>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[2,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 20>“Contact Person” means the person designated by a Party as responsible for that Party’s receipt and/or delivery of Confidential Information as indicated in Section 2 of the NDA.</SPAN 20>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[2,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 21>“Disclosing Party” means each Party that is identified as such in Section 4 of the NDA.</SPAN 21>
<SPAN 22> </SPAN 22><SPAN 23>“Effective Date” means the date identified as such in Section 3 of the NDA.</SPAN 23>
<SPAN 24>“Parties” means the entities identified as the Parties in Section 1 of the NDA; and “Party” means any one of the Parties.</SPAN 24>
<SPAN 25>“Purpose” means the reason that the Parties wish to enter into the Agreement as set forth in Section 3 of the NDA.</SPAN 25>
<SPAN 26>“Receiving Party” means each Party that receives Confidential Information from a Disclosing Party.</SPAN 26>
<SPAN 27> </SPAN 27><SPAN 28>“US Export Controlled Information” means information subject to export control by the U.S. government under the laws indicated in Section 10 hereof or otherwise.</SPAN 28>
<SPAN 29>2. Confidential Relationship</SPAN 29>
<SPAN 30>Any disclosure of Confidential Information is made in the strictest confidence. </SPAN 30><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[1,"neighbour"],[2,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 31>Each Receiving Party will make all reasonable efforts to ensure the protection, confidentiality, and security of any Confidential Information of Disclosing Party in its possession, such efforts to be no less than the degree of care employed by Receiving Party to preserve and safeguard its own confidential information, but in no event less than a reasonable degree of care. </SPAN 31><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[1,"matched"],[2,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 32>Confidential Information will be transmitted in writing and clearly marked “Confidential,” “Proprietary,” or similarly, or if disclosed orally will be reduced to writing by Disclosing Party, clearly marked “Confidential,” “Proprietary,” or similarly, and transmitted to the Contact Person of Receiving Party within thirty (30) days after oral disclosure.</SPAN 32>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[1,"neighbour"],[2,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 33>3. Non-Disclosure</SPAN 33>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 34>Receiving Party will not disclose the Confidential Information of the Disclosing Party, except as is expressly authorized by the Agreement. </SPAN 34><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 35>Each Receiving Party may disclose the Confidential Information of Disclosing Party to its own employees assisting in making an evaluation of the Confidential Information; provided, however, that such employees are advised of the confidentiality and non-use obligations hereunder and are legally obligated by written agreement or otherwise to maintain the confidentiality and non-use of the Confidential Information. </SPAN 35><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 36>In no event will a Receiving Party disclose Confidential Information to third parties unless it obtains the prior written consent of Disclosing Party; provided, that prior to any such disclosure, Receiving Party shall first obtain a written non-disclosure agreement from such third party containing terms and conditions substantially similar to those set forth herein. </SPAN 36><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-sharing-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 37>If requested, a copy of such executed agreement will be provided to Disclosing Party. </SPAN 37><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 38>In addition, if there are three or more parties to the Agreement, then Confidential Information may be shared among multiple Receiving Parties, unless Disclosing Party provides a written notice restricting such sharing of information.</SPAN 38>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[1,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 39>If a Receiving Party is legally required by court order, law, or other governmental regulation or authority to disclose certain Confidential Information received from a Disclosing Party, such disclosure may be made only after giving written notice to Disclosing Party of such legal requirement so that Disclosing Party may object to such disclosure and seek a protective order; and in any event, the disclosure shall be limited to only that portion of the Confidential Information which is legally required to be disclosed.</SPAN 39>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-limited-use-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 40>4. Non-Use</SPAN 40>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[2,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-compelled-notice-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-limited-use-v1":[[0,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 41>Receiving Party will not use any Confidential Information of Disclosing Party for any reason other than the Purpose without the prior written consent of Disclosing Party.</SPAN 41>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[0,"neighbour"],[2,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-limited-use-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 42>5. Copies</SPAN 42>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[0,"neighbour"],[1,"neighbour"],[2,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 43>Each Receiving Party agrees not to copy or record any Confidential Information of a Disclosing Party except as reasonably necessary to further the Purpose. </SPAN 43><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[0,"matched"],[1,"neighbour"],[2,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 44>Within thirty (30) days after the written request from Disclosing Party or termination of discussions relating to the Purpose, each Receiving Party will deliver all copies or records of Confidential Information in its possession or control to the appropriate Disclosing Party’s Contact Person, or will certify in writing to Disclosing Party that the Confidential Information of such Disclosing Party has been destroyed. </SPAN 44><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[0,"neighbour"],[1,"matched"],[2,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 45>Notwithstanding the foregoing, each Receiving Party may retain one archival copy of the Confidential Information received from Disclosing Party in a secure location to be used solely to determine its obligations under the Agreement.</SPAN 45>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]],"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[0,"neighbour"],[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 46>6. Continuing Obligations</SPAN 46>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[0,"neighbour"],[1,"matched"]],"source-acquisition-return-copy-retention-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 47>Each Receiving Party’s obligations under the Agreement will survive termination of the Agreement and will continue until the end of the Confidentiality Term.</SPAN 47>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[0,"matched"],[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 48>7. No License or Warranty</SPAN 48>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[0,"matched"],[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 49>No license under or title to any invention, patent, trademark, trade name or other intellectual property or other rights or interests in the Confidential Information now or hereafter owned by or controlled by any Party is granted either expressly, by implication, estoppel or otherwise by the Agreement. </SPAN 49><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-rights-term-v1":[[0,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 50>No Party will use the name of another Party without prior written consent from such other Party. </SPAN 50><SPAN 51>All Confidential Information is provided “AS IS” and without warranty, express or implied, of any kind.</SPAN 51>
<SPAN 52>8. Term</SPAN 52>
<SPAN 53>Disclosures of Confidential Information pursuant to the Agreement are to be made only during the Agreement Term as defined in Section 3 of the NDA; provided, however, the obligations of the Agreement will survive until the end of the Confidentiality Term.</SPAN 53>
<SPAN 54>9. Injunction</SPAN 54>
<SPAN 55>The Parties agree that, in the event of breach or threatened breach or intended breach of the Agreement, each Party, in addition to any other rights and remedies available to it at law or in equity, may seek injunctive or equitable relief without the necessity of posting bond or proving that it has no adequate remedy at law.</SPAN 55>
<SPAN 56>10. Compliance with Laws; U.S. Export Compliance</SPAN 56>
<SPAN 57>The Parties acknowledge that performance of the Agreement is subject to compliance with applicable United States laws, regulations, or orders including those that may relate to the export of technical data and equipment, such as International Traffic in Arms Regulations (“ITAR”) and/or Export Administration Act/Regulations (“EAR”), as may be amended, and agree to comply with all such laws, regulations or orders. </SPAN 57><SPAN 58>No Party will export, directly or indirectly, any Confidential Information without first obtaining any required export license or government approval and, in the case of Confidential Information disclosed by University, without first obtaining permission from University’s Office of Sponsored Projects. </SPAN 58><SPAN 59>In the event any Confidential Information is export-controlled, the Disclosing Party shall provide Receiving Party with written notice containing the nature of the export-controlled information, prior to any exchange of export-controlled Confidential Information.</SPAN 59>
<SPAN 60>11. Contacts</SPAN 60>
<SPAN 61>Notices under the Agreement will be given to a Party’s person set forth in Section 1 of the NDA either by prepaid, first class, certified mail, return receipt requested or by internationally recognized overnight courier to the addresses set forth in Section 1 of the NDA or other addresses as may be given from time to time under the terms of this Section 11. </SPAN 61><SPAN 62>Notice will be deemed given once the written notice is delivered at the designated address. </SPAN 62><SPAN 63>Delivery via e-mail will not constitute notice.</SPAN 63>
<SPAN 64>Confidential Information shall be delivered to the Contact Person for such Receiving Party indicated in Section 2 of the NDA or other persons specified from time to time by Receiving Party as its Contact Person by notice given in accordance with this Section 11.</SPAN 64>
<SPAN 65>12. Other Provisions</SPAN 65>
<SPAN 66>The Agreement will be governed by the laws of the State of Texas, without regard to choice of law principles. </SPAN 66><SPAN 67>No amendment to the Agreement will be effective unless in writing and signed by the Parties. </SPAN 67><SPAN 68>Neither the Agreement nor the rights and obligations of the Parties hereunder may be sold, assigned or otherwise transferred. </SPAN 68><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 69>If any provision of the Agreement is held to be unenforceable, all other provisions will continue in full force and effect. </SPAN 69><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[1,"matched"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 70>The Agreement supersedes any and all prior understandings or previous agreements between the Parties, oral or written, relating to the subject matter herein and constitutes the sole and complete agreement between the Parties related to the subject matter hereof. </SPAN 70><SOURCE_LEADS>{"source-acquisition-core-v1":[[1,"neighbour"]]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 71>Any delay by a Party to enforce any right under the Agreement shall not act as a waiver of that right, nor as a waiver of the Party’s ability to later assert that right relative to any particular factual situation. </SPAN 71><SPAN 72>The Parties acknowledge that nothing in the Agreement shall constitute a waiver of sovereign immunity by Parties that are state agencies.</SPAN 72>
<SPAN 73> </SPAN 73><SPAN 74>[End of Terms and Conditions]</SPAN 74>
